DELIVERED + codex-verified. Commits 5da5e129 (wire) + 56b8ce89 (clause-d strengthening).
WIRED (not superseded): new objectlog/hybrid-strict server profile.
- ProjectionSpec::HybridStrict selector (env_config.rs:263) + pairing (LogSpec::ObjectLog, HybridStrict)=>true
  (env_config.rs:318), gated/rejected exactly like hybrid-async (non-objectlog pairings fail closed; unit tests
  objectlog_hybrid_strict_projection_selects_profile... + non_objectlog_hybrid_strict_pairing_is_rejected).
- Runtime start() builds the real strict store: (LogSpec::ObjectLog, ProjectionSpec::HybridStrict) arm
  (lib.rs:1461) → HybridProjectionStore::with_strict_apply(true). strict defaults FALSE (relational.rs:4293/4309),
  so the existing hybrid/hybrid-async (memory-first) profiles are behaviorally UNCHANGED (verified by codex).
- Strict routing is real: apply_live/apply_live_owned/apply_recovery route through apply_durable_then_memory
  (SQLite tx.commit BEFORE apply_memory); AfterSqliteCommitBeforeMemoryApply cut fires between them (relational.rs).

AC-TXN-5 proven on the REAL strict composed backend (same composition start() builds — codex confirmed, not a
parallel store; scope = composed backend, not RESP/TCP socket, same as the rest of the suite). All four clauses,
asserted on PROJECTED STATE with real drop+reopen:
(a) SQLite-apply failure → no success + tail replays (pending 1→2 across restart, 0 lost/dup).
(b) SQLite-commit-then-memory-fail → store POISONED fail-closed (reads AND writes error, serving stops).
(c) restart → memory rehydrated from the SQLite ProjectionImage (poisoned command's durable effect recovered, pending=2).
(d) STRICT-CUT UNKNOWN-OUTCOME RETRY (strengthened after codex flagged the original as a clean-push overclaim):
    push_with_request_id struck at AfterSqliteCommitBeforeMemoryApply → durable-but-unreturned Err → drop+reopen →
    rebuild_push_idempotency_from_log (compose.rs:1459) replays the ONE original item id (replay == vec![original_id],
    projected pending stays 1 = 0 duplicate transitions); a conflicting body under the same request_id → RequestIdConflict.

Codex adversarial review (both rounds): real-path composition SOUND; strict ordering real + default path unchanged
SOUND; clauses a/b/c SOUND; clause d SOUND after strengthening (the original clean-push replay overclaim was replaced
with the genuine strict-cut unknown-outcome retry across restart).
Verify (independent re-run, 0 failed): cargo test -p pqueue-conformance ac_txn_5 → 3 passed; cargo test -p pqueue-server
-p pqueue-sqlite -p pqueue-conformance → 34 binaries ok, 499 passed, 0 failed. AC-TXN-5 both rows PASS, no GAP.
TD-004 not amended (wiring path satisfied acceptance #1 via env_config).
summary: objectlog/hybrid-strict wired into server; AC-TXN-5 all 4 clauses (incl strict-cut unknown-outcome retry) proven on real strict path; codex-verified; rows pass
